author: KEXP
description: On a journey through blues, folk, pop, and country, Seattle-based artist Sera Cahoone finds herself comforted by community on her latest release 'I've missed You All These Years.' Live on KEXP, she shares a gripping performance of "Pulling Up Roots" and more from the record.
title: Sera Cahoone performs "Pulling Up Roots" & more Live on KEXP
